title: CAD IR Phase 6 — Sweep/loft/weld_tab features + MJCF compiler
summary: Phase 6 implementation plan adding sweep/loft/weld_tab features to the CAD IR and an MJCF compiler as a second motion-sim target alongside URDF.
notes: Phased implementation plan / runbook with task checklists, code snippets, and commit messages. Has strong SPEC-like content (type definitions, Zod schemas, JSON Schema fragments, MJCF XML grammar mappings, joint-type tables) but is structured task-by-task rather than as a standalone contract. Classified DOC because the document's primary mode is procedural guidance for executing Phase 6; the SPEC-grade artifacts are embedded examples rather than the document's authoritative output. Ambiguity between SPEC and DOC; chose DOC due to runbook structure.
